evidence_basis: QUESTION_DRIVEN, single question: does TCF4 (TCF7L2) in the rescued WWOX-KO organoid return toward wild type. Scope read, and nothing else: the Results paragraph that cites the panel (p. 9, lines 1-11 of the published accepted manuscript, and its preprint counterpart at lines 302-307 of the derived layout text), the legend of Fig. EV6 panel (F), and the raster image of panel (F) itself.

The panel was read on the PREPRINT, bioRxiv v2 posted 2025-09-25 (sha256 214a74ffaac665cd11acb7b4036eb8457bf1f6e97bf8d99f34fd8d042ae21268), page 53, the single embedded JPEG of the Fig. EV6 composite (858x885 px, embedded-image sha256 prefix e8ab1acc4e4894a9), re-rendered from the page at 1200 dpi over the panel-F clip. The preprint calls it Fig. EV6F; the published article calls the same readout Supplementary Fig. 6F and the two sentences citing it are word-for-word identical except for the figure label.

The PUBLISHED Supplementary Fig. 6F was NOT read and is not held: the published supplementary volume (brain-2025-03809-File009.pdf and its thirteen derived images) is absent from this host, re-confirmed on 2026-10-25 by SHA-256 search. What is recorded here is therefore a NON-EQUIVALENT VERSION of that panel: a preprint, not peer reviewed, which may differ from the published figure. No value below may be cited as the published supplement.

Panel (F) as read: immunoblot, week 16 cerebral organoids, rows TCF-4 (~56 kDa), WWOX (46 kDa), GAPDH (36 kDa); six lanes, one per line, left to right JH-WT, WKO-1C, WKO-2C, SCAR12, WOREE, WKO-1C AAV9. Printed quantification beneath the lanes, normalised to JH-WT = 1: 1 / 1.4 / 1.3 / 1.7 / 3.1 / 0.3. No error bars, no statistics and no replicate count are shown for this panel; the legend declares no n for (F), and the mean +/- SEM and ANOVA sentence of the Fig. EV6 legend belongs to panel (B). The rescue arm is AAV9-WWOX in one knockout clone (WKO-1C), a precision the published body sentence ('rescued WWOX-KO organoids') does not carry.

Reading limit stated rather than smoothed: the GAPDH band in the WOREE lane is visibly lighter than its neighbours, which bears on the 3.1 figure; the lanes are single, so the six numbers are one blot, not a measured distribution.
